Definition: from G5086; Tiberias, the name of a town and a lake in Palestine:--Tiberias.
BiblicalUsage: Tiberias is a town on the western shore of the Sea of Galilee, and the name of the lake itself. In John 6:1, which is the sea of Tiberias. The place has its own entry in Biblical Places.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Tiberias matters because the gospel travelled through real places, and God met His people where they lived.
